answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our network enforces cryptographic stake burning where registering an identity requires burning tokens at a superlinear cost curve, O(N^1.5). An attacker funding a vast ocean of replicas faces escalating capital friction. Rare minting tickets, such as a comet voucher or jade tier license, compel exponential expenditure per fake agent, rendering mass identity spoofing mathematically unviable.
